title: Hearty Savory Mexican Pork Carnitas
description: A savory and pillowy Mexican dish featuring pork carnitas, meringue nests, and spherified elements, served on a tagliere board, dairy-free-friendly and inspired by Yucatecan cuisine.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, combine pork shoulder, orange juice, lime juice, garlic, oregano, cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the preheated oven, cooking for 2 1/2 hours or until the pork is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Using two forks, shred the pork into bite-sized pieces.
Strain the cooking liquid and discard the solids.
Add the strained liquid back to the pot and bring it to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the liquid by half, stirring occasionally.
To spherify the liquid, mix 1 tablespoon of sodium alginate with 1 cup of water and add it to the reduced liquid.
Drop the spherified liquid into a bath of cold water to set the spheres.
To assemble the dish, place a meringue nest on each plate, followed by a spoonful of the pork carnitas and a few spherified spheres.
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F, then rest 3 minutes before serving.
